workItems.title: Finish Healthcheck exact-package example and close shared three-feature acceptance
workItems.acceptanceCriteria: Satisfy proposal AC-1 through AC-5: retain applicable Logging and Type Manager accepted workflows/results without replay; execute the actual CountryList source from the retained exact package in ordinary build and folder-published output with all four startup stories, truthful Core identity and meaningful pending/readiness/failure/refresh/recovery/drain assertions; demonstrate HTTP and same-identity pipe/matching probe 0/1/2 behavior on actual Windows11x64 and Ubuntu24.04x64; deliver accurate existing guides, one compact per-feature closure, independent review, cleanup and settled history.
workItems.validation: Inspect native nonempty selection for CountryListPackageTests and affected CountryListStartupStories; run only these ordinary MSTest/VSTest cases through CIS with PerformanceObservation/ExtendedStress excluded, SDK10.0.401 and NET/ASP.NET10.0.12, same candidate de794bafcee21b8a667bb3558e45242fddbab3f8eb7ca3b04974c5037628d93e on both platforms. Independently hash executed Core against packaged payload. Reference unchanged prior Logging/Type Manager reports and record bounded currentness diagnosis; strict docs and plan checks; one focused independent review of actual consumer/failure/continuation; preserve old costs/results and release obligations.
